Interface ChangeDataHolderWrapper<Self extends DataHolder.Mutable<Self>>

Type Parameters:
Self - The class type that is implementing this
All Superinterfaces:
DataHolder<Self>, DataHolder.Mutable<Self>
public interface ChangeDataHolderWrapper<Self extends DataHolder.Mutable<Self>> extends DataHolder.Mutable<Self>
An implementation as an interface of the DataHolder.Mutable. This implementation is designed for ChangeHolder.Child and therefore all changes are stored within changes(). This ChangeStore should be linked in the ChangeHolder.Child.commitDirectChanges()
